parameters.toolDescription: Search for Reddit posts about Korean football players using the Arctic Shift historical Reddit archive. Use this to find posts by player name, team, or related keywords. Try multiple query variations: full name, last name only, team + name. Returns posts with id, title, score, subreddit, permalink, num_comments, and created_utc timestamp. Use the post id and subreddit from results to fetch comments with the reddit_comments_fetch tool. Focus on posts with score > 5 or num_comments > 3 for quality discussions.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('query', 'Search query string. Try player name, team name, or combination. Examples: Oh Hyeon-Gyu, Besiktas Oh, Kim Min-jae Bayern', 'string') }}

parameters.name: subreddit
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('subreddit', 'Subreddit to search in without r/ prefix, e.g. soccer, besiktas, fcbayern. Leave empty string to search all subreddits.', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Fetch top comments from a specific Reddit post. Use this after finding posts with arctic_shift_search. Returns the post data and top comments with author, score, body text, and author flair. IMPORTANT: Only fetch comments for ONE post at a time to avoid Reddit rate limiting.
parameters.url: ={{ 'https://www.reddit.com/r/' + $fromAI('subreddit', 'Subreddit name without r/ prefix, e.g. soccer, besiktas, fcbayern', 'string') + '/comments/' + $fromAI('post_id', 'Reddit post ID from Arctic Shift search results (the id field of a post)', 'string') + '.json' }}
